metric.name: frame_p95_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT dur AS ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dur) AS rank, count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM frames
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n * 95 + 99) / 100) AS value

claims.text: The app's frame p95 increased from 19.914166 ms in the baseline to 36.011542 ms in the current trace, a 16.097375999999997 ms increase.

claims.text: The regression is in the Jetnews app's UI process: the current trace has 77 app frames with a 42.042041 ms maximum and 18.7539793636364 ms average, versus 75 frames with a 34.190667 ms maximum and 15.6105094 ms average in the baseline.

citations.sql:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
SELECT p.name AS process_name, t.name AS thread_name, f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, count(*) AS frame_count, max(a.dur) / 1e6 AS max_frame_ms, avg(a.dur) / 1e6 AS avg_frame_ms
FROM android_frames_layers AS f
JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
JOIN process AS p ON p.upid = f.upid
JOIN thread AS t ON t.utid = f.ui_thread_utid
WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
GROUP BY f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid
ORDER BY frame_count DESC

    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1

claims.text: Commit ef58dc9dfbf9f06155d11669df2e9ef7040e4ce1 changes SelectTopicButton from 36 dp to 40 dp, increasing the layout size of a Compose UI element; it is the strongest correlated candidate in the range.

caveats: the current trace's build was debuggable (run metadata: debuggable), so ART ran it with fewer optimisations and its timings overstate a release build's
Each side has only one capture, so some of the increase may be run-to-run noise.
The captures were made on an Android emulator (sdk_gphone64_arm64, SDK 36) using a debuggable debug build.
The trace shows increased Compose and measure/layout activity, but it does not directly identify the changed SelectTopicButton callsite; attribution is therefore correlated rather than direct.
